text:
Priya: Quick sync — customer bakeoff next week. Need a prioritized cut of observability asks we can commit to for Beta. Two high-priority asks from Eng + CS: per-route cost breakdown in Console; lightweight tracing hooks (service->model spans) for cold-path debugging.
Jasper: Can we scope both for Beta? cost UI needs backend aggregation, tracing needs a small agent hook. Risk: rollout infra + perf overhead.
Mina: Tracing doable if sampling low and async exporter. Concern: KV cache spans could blow up cardinality.
Carlos: Top customers on Dedicated/Private want cost attribution to route + team tag. Also retention 90d for audits.
Elena: UI: want a compact 'cost lens' card + trace link from error rows. Sketch: https://figma.example/ocb123 :eyes: (will share real link).
Priya: Proposed prioritization: 1) per-route cost (must-have for sales demos) 2) tracing hooks (should-have) 3) error analytics enrichment (nice-to-have).
Jasper: Estimates: cost backend + pipeline ~3 dev-weeks; frontend 1w. Tracing hooks ~2 dev-weeks + config flags + SRE validation.
Mina: Make tracing opt-in per-deployment and default sample 0.1%. Add KV span filter to avoid explosion.
Priya: Draft launch criteria:
- per-route cost: accurate within 5% on sample workloads; token-level breakdown shown in Console; route tagging enabled.
- tracing hooks: span view with model/op tags; <200ms overhead p95 on sampled requests.
- both: rollout plan, feature flagging, docs, and customer demo flows.
Jasper: Implementation plan: A) backend aggregation jobs (batch/stream) B) runtime emits traces/metrics (opt-in) C) console cards + drilldowns + export.
Carlos: Customer asks we include export to CSV and raw event stream for billing systems.
Elena: UX acceptance: small card, drilldown funnel, trace link from error rows, export button. I'll prepare mocks by EOD Fri.
Priya: Timeline: pick up cost aggregation this sprint, tracing in next sprint. @Jasper pls confirm resource split by EOD.
Jasper: Confirmed. Allocating 2 engineers: infra + console. ETA: cost feature 3w, tracing POC 2w.
Mina: I'll run perf tests once POC is ready and own rollout playbook for sampling changes.
Priya: Next steps: assign tickets, define canary metrics (token cost delta, trace overhead), schedule customer demos. I'll assemble a short one-pager and share.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: PRODOBS-4123 per-route-cost-aggregation assigned to @Jasper
Carlos: :thumbsup:
Priya: Tagging this thread 'visibility-bakeoff' for follow-up."
